tradeLink.title: Trade link
tradeLink.hint: The seller sends your skin here. Save it once.
tradeLink.steps: In Steam open Inventory → Trade Offers → "Who can send me Trade Offers?". Copy the link from the "Trade URL" field.

status.ok: The link works — your skin arrives right away.
status.hold: Steam will hold the trade: Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator is off on this account. Turn it on in the Steam app and the skin arrives right away.
status.invalid: The link doesn't work. Copy it again from Steam.
status.private: Your inventory is private. Make it public in Steam privacy settings.
status.trade_ban: This account has a Steam trade restriction. A skin can't be sent to it.
status.unavailable: We couldn't check it right now. The link is saved — we'll check before you buy.

errors.trade_link_invalid: That isn't a Steam trade link. It starts with https://steamcommunity.com/tradeoffer/new/
errors.trade_link_not_yours: That link belongs to another Steam account. Use the one you signed in with.
errors.generic: Couldn't save it. Please try again.
